operators.customDisplayName: Load water-body-testing-2013.csv via pd.read_csv (defaults: comma delimiter, first row as header, UTF-8) to analyze Massachusetts beach water samples and bacterial standard exceedances during 2013 bathing season

operatorProperties.code:
def process(waterBodyTesting2013) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    df = waterBodyTesting2013.copy()

    # Massachusetts beaches: interpret as all records in this dataset (Massachusetts DEP beach testing)
    # 2013 bathing season: all samples in year 2013 (dataset already restricted to 2013)
    df = df[df['Year'] == 2013]

    # Exceeded bacterial standards leading to temporary closures: Violation == 'yes'
    total = len(df)
    violated = (df['Violation'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower() == 'yes').sum()

    pct = (violated / total) * 100 if total else float('nan')

    return pd.DataFrame([{
        'total_samples': total,
        'samples_exceeded_standard': int(violated),
        'percent_exceeded': pct
    }])

operators.customDisplayName: Compute percent of 2013 Massachusetts beach water samples exceeding bacterial standards (temporary closure proxy): filter Year==2013; count rows where Violation (case/whitespace-normalized) == 'yes'; percent_exceeded = 100 * count_yes / total; return [total_samples, samples_exceeded_standard, percent_exceeded].
